toegepas.blok: Die koning, sy izinduna en sy krygers
toegepas.voor: Hy het hulp gehad van izinduna (een is 'n induna), leiers met gesag namens hom.
toegepas.na: Izinduna (een is 'n induna) het hom gehelp. Hulle was leiers wat namens hom gesag gehad het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hulp gehad van' calques 'had help from', and 'leiers met gesag namens hom' is a wooden noun phrase; a relative clause reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'Hy het hulp gehad van' copies English 'had help from', and the appended noun phrase is stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two plain sentences with the same people and roles; izinduna, induna and gesag stay intact and 'Sy krygers' still points to Shaka.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Goed' is colloquial here; 'goedere' is the standard word and matches the glossary definition of eerbetoon.
toegepas.fout: 'ander goed' is loose and colloquial for tribute.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Goedere' is the precise word, keeps the meaning and matches the lesson's own definition of eerbetoon.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Versigtig' is the more natural and grade-appropriate word than the formal 'met sorg'.
toegepas.fout: 'met sorg' is stiff and formal for a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Versigtig' is the plain spoken word and fits the sense of reading sources that contradict and exaggerate.

laat_vaar.blok: Die koning, sy izinduna en sy krygers
laat_vaar.voor: gedra, dus was baie beeste nodig
laat_vaar.na: gedra, en daarom was baie beeste nodig
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Dus' after a bare comma is a run-on; 'en daarom' links the two clauses properly, with the AWS comma before 'en'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: ', dus was' is accepted Afrikaans for a consequence; 'en daarom' only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: Lank voor Shaka het 'n vroeë opperhoof
laat_vaar.na: Lank voor Shaka se tyd het 'n opperhoof
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Lank voor Shaka se tyd' is the natural phrase, and 'vroeë' then only repeats 'lank voor'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Lank voor Shaka' already reads well, and dropping 'vroeë' loses a word that carries information about the kind of leader.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The next sentence and the block heading use 'gerus'; one verb throughout avoids suggesting two different ideas.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Berus op' is the exact, natural verb; swapping it for 'gerus' is lateral and only adds repetition with the next sentence.

laat_vaar.blok: Handel met Britse en Portugese handelaars (kaart)
laat_vaar.voor: Op albei plekke is met handelaars handel gedryf.
laat_vaar.na: Op albei plekke is daar met handelaars handel gedryf.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: An impersonal passive reads more naturally with 'daar'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: With 'Op albei plekke' in first position 'daar' is optional, so the change is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: waarvan 'n olifant se slagtande gemaak is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Gemaak is' suggests someone made the tusks; 'bestaan uit' is the natural way to say what something consists of.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Waarvan ... gemaak is' is the normal Afrikaans for 'made of' and implies no maker; this is a glossary definition and the original has no real fault.

na_skrywer.voor: dat hy Shaka gehelp het om 'n spieswond te versorg ná 'n aanval op sy lewe
na_skrywer.na: dat hy gehelp het om Shaka se spieswond te versorg ná 'n aanval op die koning se lewe
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written, Shaka tends 'a' wound and 'sy lewe' could be Fynn's; this makes clear whose wound and whose life.
na_skrywer.fout: As written, Shaka is the one tending 'a' spear wound with Fynn's help, and 'sy lewe' could be Fynn's or Shaka's.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real, but the proposal decides whose wound it was and moves Shaka's role, which is a content call for the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Hulle weerspreek mekaar soms en oordryf dinge.
vlae.rede: It is unclear whether 'soms' also governs 'oordryf dinge'; the meaning cannot be settled without knowing the intended claim, so it is not changed.
